description: This file is a build and setup script for the 'MLT component' within a larger software project. It handles environment setup, argument parsing, build commands, cleaning, rebuilding, and installation procedures with a focus on a specific hardware platform (Broadcom). It contains functions for configuring, building, cleaning, rebuilding, and installing the component, and manages environment variables and external scripts.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Performs pre-build configuration tasks (currently a placeholder).

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Cleans the build environment (currently a placeholder).

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the component and its led controller, utilizing make with parallel jobs.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Performs a clean build by setting VLCLEAN=1 and invoking build.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs built binaries and creates necessary symbol links.
